changes: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/code/composerCharts — the response property `results/composerCharts/items/dashboardSlug` became nullable for the status `200`
GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/code/composerCharts — the response property `results/composerCharts/items/dashboardSlug` became optional for the status `200`

declaredAdvisories.reason: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/code/composerCharts now returns dashboardSlug as null for a composer chart a space owns. The Lightdash CLI is the only caller. A CLI older than this change downloads such a chart; its lint accepts the null dashboardSlug, and uploading the file back is refused by the server with a named error, so nothing changes or is lost. No space-owned chart can be created until a later release, so during a rolling update every file an old CLI downloads still names its dashboard.

impact.firstPartyOnly: Only the Lightdash CLI calls this endpoint, from lightdash download. An older CLI's upload of a space-owned file is refused by the server rather than losing data.
